name: Docuseal
description: Document Signing for Everyone free forever for individuals, extensible for businesses and developers. Open Source Alternative to DocuSign, PandaDoc and more.
composeYaml:
services:
  docuseal:
    image: 'docuseal/docuseal:latest'
    environment:
      - 'HOST=${APP_URL}'
    volumes:
      - 'docuseal-data:/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - '-q'
        - '--spider'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:3000'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10

meta.about: Create, fill, and sign digital documents (alternative to DocuSign).
